params.prompt: Edit image 1 (a black-and-white 1960s photograph of a Zagreb square with one pale-blue tram as the only colour). Replace the round building in the centre with the REAL Mestrovic Pavilion in Zagreb exactly as shown in reference images 2 and 3: a large white-stone circular rotunda surrounded by a continuous ring of tall, slender, closely spaced rectangular stone pillars (about 36 of them) reaching from the stepped base up to a plain, smooth, wide cylindrical stone band at the top; a very low shallow dome barely visible above; no classical capitals, no pediment, no windows in the upper band; the building stands on a low circular stepped plinth with a broad staircase at the front, on a round open plaza. It must look monumental and elegant, wider than tall. Keep everything else from image 1: the surrounding Central European apartment blocks, the pale-blue 1960s tram (the only coloured element), period cars, pedestrians in 1960s coats and hats, overcast light, film grain, photorealistic documentary photograph. No text, no signs.
